definitions.gloss: gentle; gradual; smooth (of a slope or curve)
definitions.explanation: Describes a slope, hill, or surface that rises or descends gradually without steep inclines.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧なだらかな⟦{坂|さか}→坂：01415_saka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: This road has a series of gentle slopes.

examples.japanese: なだらかな⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}けた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: The mountain path was gentle enough for even children to walk easily.

notes:
なだらか is a na-adjective that primarily describes physical terrain. It implies a gradual, smooth incline rather than a flat surface.

FORMS:
- Modifier: なだらかな⟦{坂|さか}→坂：01415_saka⟧ (a gentle slope)
- Adverbial: なだらか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{下|くだ}る→下る：03913_kudaru⟧ (to descend gradually)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- なだらかな⟦{坂|さか}→坂：01415_saka⟧: gentle slope
- なだらかな⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧: gentle hill
- なだらかな⟦{曲線|きょくせん}→曲線：05441_kyokusen⟧: smooth curve
- なだらか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|のぼ}る→上る：21460_noboru⟧: to climb gradually

SIMILAR WORDS:
- なだらか: gentle, gradual
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧: steep, sharp
